Answer: A
Reason: The chest radiograph demonstrates multiple small, scattered nodular opacities with a random distribution throughout both lung fields, some of which appear dense/calcified. This pattern is characteristic of healed varicella (chickenpox) pneumonia, whereas the other options describe findings (cavitation, large mass/effusion, reticular fibrosis, or diffuse alveolar infiltrates) that are not present in this image.
